unit_fighter: Korean People's Army Air Force, Fighter Aviation Regiment {number}
unit_attack: Korean People's Army Air Force, Ground-Attack Aviation Regiment {number}
book_cover_flag: Order booklet of the Order of the National Flag - Democratic People's Republic of Korea
book_cover_soldier: Order booklet of the Soldier's Medal of Honour - Democratic People's Republic of Korea
book_cover_freedom: Order booklet of the Order of Freedom and Independence - Democratic People's Republic of Korea
book_received: Has received the following order - order number
book_certify: Certifies that, under the regulations on the {order}, the holder has received this order and enjoys all the privileges and rights it carries. Kang Ryang-uk, Secretary of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly.
decree_flag: Decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly establishing the Order of the National Flag, 1st to 3rd class, of {date} - the text printed in the booklet of 1949. Signed by Kim Du-bong, chairman, and Kang Ryang-uk, secretary.
decree_soldier_modelled: Decree establishing the Soldier's Medal of Honour, 1st and 2nd class, of {date}. Reconstructed after the National Flag booklet: its exact wording is not known.
decree_freedom_modelled: Decree establishing the Order of Freedom and Independence, 1st and 2nd class, of {date}. Reconstructed after the National Flag booklet: its exact wording is not known.
hero_title: Certificate of commendation of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, given with the title Hero of the DPRK (regulations of 30 June 1950, article 3). No original survives in the sources; this is a reconstruction.
hero_body: By its decree of {date} the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly conferred on the comrade, for heroic deeds for the homeland and the people, the title Hero of the DPRK, the Order of the National Flag 1st class and the Gold Star medal.
hero_body_second: By its decree of {date} the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly awarded the comrade a second Gold Star medal for further heroic deeds. Under the regulations a bronze statue recording his deeds is raised in his home town.
hero_signers: Kim Du-bong, Chairman, and Kang Ryang-uk, Secretary, of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly
